title: RelatedPhrase
description: One idiom or phrasal verb built on a headword, as GET /phrases/of lists them. The phrase has its own full entry; this is the line that links to it.

phrase.description: The canonical phrase; a key into `entries`.

kind.description: `phrasal` when the phrase is the headword plus particles only (get up, get away with); `idiom` otherwise (get cold feet).

partOfSpeech.description: The phrase's part of speech in Hindi, from its first sense.

meaning.description: The phrase's first Hindi sense — the headline for the list.
